title: Narrowing the Overdraft Charges Under Review on a Personal Checking Account
content:
Two relationship cases narrow the set of overdraft charges that make up the charges under review on a Personal Checking account.

**First case.** Where the owner's premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts reaches the tier's relationship maintenance threshold and at least 4 overdraft charges stand on the account, only the overdraft charges posted inside the review window are summed. The review window runs back 1 calendar month from the day the matter is handled.

**Second case.** Where the case above does not apply and either at least 2 overdraft charges stand on the account or the owner has made at least 20 card payments under Personal Credit Cards in the last twelve months, only the largest single overdraft charge is taken.

**Otherwise.** Where neither case applies, the charges under review are not narrowed in either of these ways.

The relationship maintenance threshold is the tier's own figure:

| Tier | Relationship maintenance threshold (USD) |
|---|---|
| Access Checking | not offered |
| Student Checking | not offered |
| Everyday Checking | 5000.00 |
| Interest Checking | 15000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 25000.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 250000.00 |

**Worked narrowing on hypothetical inputs.** An account carries overdraft charges of 35.00, 35.00 and 30.00, the first two posted inside the review window and the third posted four months ago.

| Owner's position | Charges under review |
|---|---|
| Premier money market balance at or above the tier's threshold, 5 charges standing | 70.00, being the two charges inside the review window |
| Premier money market balance below the tier's threshold, 3 charges standing | 35.00, being the largest single charge |
| Premier money market balance below the tier's threshold, 3 charges standing, 25 card payments in the last twelve months | 35.00, either limb of the second case being met |

On a different account, one carrying a single overdraft charge of 40.00:

| Owner's position | Charges under review |
|---|---|
| Premier money market balance below the tier's threshold, 1 charge standing, 25 card payments | 40.00, the card payment limb of the second case being met |
| Premier money market balance below the tier's threshold, 1 charge standing, 6 card payments | Neither case applies |

Equality satisfies each threshold: exactly 4 charges standing with a qualifying premier money market balance reaches the first case, and exactly 2 charges standing reaches the second.
